rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(v) and Article 117(2) of the Constitution, Decree No. 264 announces the dismissal ('Объявить об отставке') of the Government of the Russian Federation; point 4 puts it into force on signature; signed 'Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин', Moscow, Kremlin, 24 February 2004, No. 264.

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 2 entrusts the temporary performance of the duties of the Chairman of the Government to Deputy Chairman of the Government Христенко В.Б. (surname and initials only).

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 3 instructs the Government to perform its duties until a new Government is formed.
